author: reek
body: `[Process]` is the effect row guarding `get-args`, `get-env`, `current-dir`, `run-process`, `run-process-full` and `process-exit`, and until now no Codex program could declare it. `Process` was absent from capability-vocabulary, so `opening : [Process] ...` was refused with CDX4001, "no capability the manifest can carry" -- and the refusal is in the type checker rather than in manifest emission, so it fired on every target, the transpilers and IR included. The entire family resolved, type-checked, and could not be called by anything.

author: reek
body: It is a carriable capability now: one bit, one cap id, the same shape as Gpu or Identity. Its operations stay host-only and unimplemented on bare metal, which is the `Camera` arrangement and not a new kind of half-measure.

author: reek
body: The test can fail, which is the point of picking this instrument. It reports the bit rather than asserting the program compiled: a program that merely compiles proves only that CDX4001 stopped firing, and would read exactly the same if the bit were dropped between the row and the grant.
